summary: Five objections to the round-one theory brief. Two are structural: decisions B and C are coupled because the product has no blank state, so A3 and B1 are not implementable as written; and acceptance criterion 5 can be satisfied under A1 by a token migration that resolves nothing. Three are corrections: the five named-photographer files split 3+2 on the brief's own axis, the procedural-cover assumption is now a measured finding that narrows C, and five references to the task-id conflict are stale.
assumptions: Measurements in this report were taken at fa102fc against the working tree; js/app.js line numbers refer to that commit.
The brief's A/B/C/D structure is accepted; these objections concern implementability and evidence, not the owner's authority to choose.
No legal conclusion is stated or implied by any objection here.
accepted_points: The four-decision A/B/C/D structure, each option carrying an explicit consequence.
The scope boundary excluding architecture-document sections 1, 3, 6 and 7 to a future PLATFORM objective.
Dropping the unverified GESAM reference and requiring organisation-level verification before any future licensing route relies on it.
Preserving exact CC licence family and version rather than one conditional tier.
Holding named-photographer assertions apart from the unnamed-media case.
Display permission and model-training permission are separate; RIGHTS-001 authorises no training use.
Treating C as the highest-uncertainty question.
Gate 1 remains in force: this round authorises no production edit, implementation, merge or deployment.
disputed_points: CH-1: A3 and B1 are not implementable in the current product. js/app.js:2190 gates on image.src && status=='pd', and the else branch at 2204 renders canvasTag unconditionally, so withholding an image yields the artist-associated procedural cover rather than no image. A3's own escape clause concedes this. D2 therefore offers as three independent conservative choices a package that reduces to one, C3.

CH-2: acceptance criterion 5 is satisfiable under A1 without resolving anything. TestPdTokenAccuracy skips any record not carrying the literal status:"pd", so migrating the five to a new basis token drops the count 6 to 1 through a declared record change while the files, assertions and unknown jurisdiction are unchanged.

CH-3: the five named-photographer files are themselves an undifferentiated bucket. Three are photographs of three-dimensional works; black-fuji and vahine-no-te-tiare are photographs of flat works by the same Commons contributor. That is the axis the brief applies everywhere else, and A2's cost profile differs because re-sourcing both replaces one person's work twice.

CH-4: the assumption that no artwork pixels feed the covers is now measured — 279 hand-authored palettes, no pixel sampling in the paint path — which removes derivation as a live possibility and makes C2 a larger product change than stated, since it removes an authored curatorial judgement rather than a derivation.
CH-5: five references to the task-id contract conflict are stale, resolved at 18e35b6 which is in this brief's own ancestry.
proposal: See protocol/tasks/RIGHTS-001/challenge-adaptation-report.md. Return the smallest revision that (a) declares the B-C coupling and either conditions A3/B1 on C3 or funds a genuine no-image surface as a deliverable, (b) rewrites criterion 5 so a token migration carries the ratchet with it or explicitly retires and replaces the count, (c) splits Decision A into 3+2 or states why the flat/three-dimensional axis does not govern there, (d) promotes the procedural-cover assumption to a finding and restates C2's consequence, and (e) strikes the five stale task-id references.
rationale: The brief's structure is sound and is not relitigated. The two structural objections would each let an owner select an option believing it does something it does not do: A3 and B1 read as withholding but render a cover, and criterion 5 reads as measuring resolution but measures the presence of a string. Both are the failure this project names as a proxy checked for the thing, and both are cheap to fix before specification freeze and expensive after.
evidence: tests/test_rights_tooling.py TestPdTokenAccuracy (literal status:"pd" filter, continue on absence)
js/artists-*.js (279 hand-authored palettes); js/app.js:815-850 (paint path, no getImageData or drawImage of a source)
Commons file pages for black-fuji ({{art photo}}, {{self|cc-by-3.0}}, Sailko) and vahine-no-te-tiare ({{Information}}, {{self|cc-by-sa-4.0}}, Francesco Bini)
18e35b6 and tests/test_protocol_ids.py (task-id contract resolved; envelope validates with zero violations, unrenamed)
requested_actions: Revise the brief per CH-1 through CH-5, or defend each objection on the evidence cited.
Do not widen scope: the objections require no backend, database, runtime policy engine or new source.
State whether a genuine no-image artwork surface is to be funded by an option, and if so which.
Preserve the 3+2 distinction in Decision A if it is accepted, so a later specification cannot re-merge it.
acceptance_criteria: Every objection is either adopted in the revised brief or answered with reasoning against the specific evidence cited.
The revised brief states, for each of A, B, C and D, whether the option set depends on another decision, and names the dependency.
No revision introduces a backend, database, scheduled job, private asset store or runtime territorial evaluation.
No revision asserts a legal conclusion, and the prohibited-language guard reports no new assertion of legal status.
The five stale task-id references are removed.
risks: If the B-C coupling stays undeclared, an owner may select the D2 conservative package believing it is three independent choices when it reduces to C3.
If criterion 5 stands, A1 produces a green ratchet and an unresolved question, weakening the guard for every future rights finding.
If Decision A keeps the five as one class, a later specification may treat photographs of flat and three-dimensional works identically, which is the R1 defect the brief was written to avoid.
Challenging structure rather than substance could be read as delay; it is not, and the report accepts eight of the brief's positions without qualification.
confidence: high: every objection rests on a line of code, a test filter, a file page or a commit read this round; low only on whether the owner will judge the missing no-image surface worth funding
